newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian 154-day bill average yield 36.77 percent.
newsitem.headline: Russian 154-day bill average yield 36.77 percent.

text.p: The annualised average yield on an issue of 154-day GKO discount Treasury bills was 36.77 percent at an auction on Wednesday, the central bank said.
The average yield on an issue of 227-day T-bills on January 5 was 36.94 percent.
The series 22053 bills maturing June 4, which are closest in outstanding maturity to the new paper, closed on Monday with a yield of 35.32 percent. Tuesday was a holiday in Russia.
The finance ministry is also auctioning 7.50 trillion roubles of 266-day bills (series 22067) on Wednesday.

On January 8 the Finance Ministry is also repaying about 6.70 trillion roubles of maturing six-month bills (series 22038), and paying around 629 billion roubles in quarterly interest on the 18-month OFZ interest-bearing government bond (series 24005) maturing July 9, 1997.
The new bills are subject to the existing tax regime, under which income from government securities is tax-free, finance ministry and central bank officials said.

Parliament approved a 15 percent tax on income from government securities at the end of last year but it has not yet come into force. Securities issued before the tax comes into effect will not be taxable.
